# agentgateway_traffic_route (Resource)

Manages a traffic route: the HTTP matches and backends that agentgateway serves on one or more gateways.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A route served by the default gateway. Requests to /api that carry the
# x-tenant header and a version query parameter are forwarded to a local
# service.
resource "agentgateway_traffic_route" "api" {
  name      = "api"
  gateways  = ["default"]
  namespace = "default"
  rule_name = "api"

  hostnames = ["api.example.com"]

  matches {
    path {
      prefix = "/api"
    }
    method = "GET"

    headers {
      name  = "x-tenant"
      exact = "acme"
    }

    query {
      name  = "version"
      regex = "^v[0-9]+$"
    }
  }

  backends {
    weight = 1
    host   = "127.0.0.1:8080"
  }

  policies_json = jsonencode({
    cors = {
      allowOrigins = ["https://example.com"]
    }
  })
}

# Weighted backends: 80% of the traffic goes to the stable service and 20% to
# the canary. Both use the service JSON form the gateway understands.
resource "agentgateway_traffic_route" "canary" {
  name      = "canary"
  gateways  = ["default"]
  hostnames = ["canary.example.com"]

  matches {
    path {
      exact = "/"
    }
  }

  backends {
    weight = 80

    service_json = jsonencode({
      name = "stable"
      port = 8080
    })
  }

  backends {
    weight = 20

    service_json = jsonencode({
      name = "canary"
      port = 8080
    })
  }
}

# A route that forwards to another named backend. `backend` is a bare backend
# name, not an object.
resource "agentgateway_traffic_route" "tools" {
  name     = "tools"
  gateways = ["default"]

  matches {
    path {
      prefix = "/tools"
    }
  }

  backends {
    backend = "mcp-tools"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The route name. Changing it renames the route in place.

### Optional

- `backends` (Block List) Destinations of the route. Exactly one variant may be set per backend. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--backends))
- `gateways` (List of String) Gateways that serve this route, as `<gateway>` or `<gateway>/<listener>`. The server defaults to `default`.
- `hostnames` (List of String) Hostnames served by this route. Wildcards are allowed; unset serves all hostnames.
- `matches` (Block List) Request matches. A request is served when any match applies. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--matches))
- `namespace` (String) Namespace of the route.
- `policies_json` (String) Route-level policies as JSON.
- `rule_name` (String) Rule name used by authorization policies.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The route name, which is also the server-side id.
- `revision` (Number) The server revision of the stored route.

<a id="nestedblock--backends"></a>
### Nested Schema for `backends`

Optional:

- `ai_json` (String) AI backend as JSON. Exactly one backend variant may be set.
- `backend` (String) Name of a backend to route to, as a bare string. Exactly one backend variant may be set.
- `host` (String) Direct host backend as a bare string, for example `example.com:8000` or a URI such as `http://127.0.0.1:8080`. Exactly one backend variant may be set.
- `json` (String) Any other backend as JSON (`aws`, `dynamic`, `internal`, `routeGroup`). Exactly one backend variant may be set.
- `mcp_json` (String) MCP backend as JSON. Exactly one backend variant may be set.
- `service_json` (String) Service backend as JSON, `{name, port}`. Exactly one backend variant may be set.
- `weight` (Number) Relative weight of this backend. The server default is `1`.


<a id="nestedblock--matches"></a>
### Nested Schema for `matches`

Optional:

- `headers` (Block List) Header matches. All headers must match. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--matches--headers))
- `method` (String) HTTP method to match, for example `GET`.
- `path` (Block List) Path match. Exactly one of `exact`, `prefix` or `regex` may be set. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--matches--path))
- `query` (Block List) Query parameter matches. All parameters must match. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--matches--query))

<a id="nestedblock--matches--headers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `matches.headers`

Required:

- `name` (String) Header name.

Optional:

- `exact` (String) Match the header value exactly. Exactly one of `exact` or `regex` may be set.
- `regex` (String) Match the header value with a regular expression. Exactly one of `exact` or `regex` may be set.


<a id="nestedblock--matches--path"></a>
### Nested Schema for `matches.path`

Optional:

- `exact` (String) Match the path exactly.
- `prefix` (String) Match a path prefix.
- `regex` (String) Match the path with a regular expression.


<a id="nestedblock--matches--query"></a>
### Nested Schema for `matches.query`

Required:

- `name` (String) Query parameter name.

Optional:

- `exact` (String) Match the parameter value exactly. Exactly one of `exact` or `regex` may be set.
- `regex` (String) Match the parameter value with a regular expression. Exactly one of `exact` or `regex` may be set.
